reasons.legacy: Asserts the payload of a NetSuite integration whose legacy_script setting is true. No service, mutation or API of v1.55.0 sets it (it is only declared, app/models/integrations/netsuite_integration.rb:8, and read, app/services/integrations/aggregator/contacts/payloads/netsuite.rb:72), so every integration has it false and Tanvo has no such setting; the false cases are ported.
